create_ernie45_moe_causal_lm: create an Ernie45 MoE causal language model from a VllmConfig for inference
build_ernie45_moe_decoder_layer: build a decoder layer with attention and MoE or dense MLP based on config
run_ernie45_moe_forward: run the Ernie45 MoE model forward pass with input ids and positions
load_ernie45_moe_weights: load HuggingFace-compatible weights into the Ernie45 MoE model
compute_ernie45_moe_logits: compute logits from hidden states using the Ernie45 MoE LM head
